$comment: Type-check gate only — never used to run or deploy the function. Resolves @solvapay/* from workspace source instead of the @preview dist-tag, so a feature branch can prove its SDK change type-checks under Deno before merging. Deployment uses supabase/functions/mcp/deno.json and local serve uses deno.local.json; both stay on @preview. This file lives at the example root, not beside those two, because `nodeModulesDir: manual` makes Deno look for node_modules next to the config — only here does it find the pnpm-populated tree.
